visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular Asian man with styled black hair and a grey sleeveless tank top stands in a brightly lit indoor studio. He is positioned behind a light wooden table where several protein-related items are neatly arranged: a red and white carton, a brown carton, a blue and white carton, and a vacuum-sealed snack. He gestures broadly with his hands while looking directly into the lens. (2) The scene cuts to a high-detail close-up shot focusing on the nutrition label of a product. A yellow semi-transparent highlight box emphasizes a carbohydrate value of 21g and a calorie count of 262kcal. The man's fingers are visible at the edges of the frame, holding the carton steady against the light. The background is slightly blurred, keeping focus on the text. (3) Another close-up reveals a different part of the product's ingredient list. Specific terms like '奶粉', '大豆蛋白', and '米蛋白' are highlighted with yellow rectangles. The lighting remains bright and even, ensuring every character on the packaging is sharp and readable. The man's hands are used to point at the relevant sections. (4) The camera returns to a medium shot of the man, who is now holding two different cartons. He compares them by moving them closer to the camera and then back. He uses emphatic facial expressions, squinting his eyes and nodding his head, to reinforce his verbal points. Large variety-style text overlays appear around him to emphasize the nutritional data. (5) In the final visual phase, the man continues his explanation while multiple floating graphics appear on the screen, showing various numerical values for protein and fat. Images of different packaged chicken snacks are superimposed on the screen as he presents them as better alternatives. The background remains the same neutral grey wall with a visible light switch on the right.
